title: Classic Potato Salad
description: Tender potatoes tossed while warm with a little vinegar, then folded into a creamy dressing with celery, eggs and herbs.

image.alt: A bowl of creamy potato salad with celery, egg and chives

steps.text: Cover the potatoes with cold, well-salted water, bring to a boil and simmer until just tender when pierced, {time 10-12 min}. Don’t let them fall apart.
Drain and spread on a tray, then sprinkle with the vinegar while hot; warm potatoes soak up the flavor. Cool to room temperature, {time 20 min}.
Stir the mayonnaise, mustard, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Fold in the potatoes, eggs, celery, onion and dill. Chill for at least {time 1 hr notimer} before serving.

notes: Keep mayonnaise-based salads cold. Don’t leave them out for more than 2 hours (1 hour on a hot day).
